visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a clean kitchen counter filled with various ingredients including cabbage, pork, tofu, and Korean condiments. (2) A person's hand enters the frame holding a light grey ceramic pot, showing its interior. (3) Close-up shots highlight specific ingredients: a jar of kimchi, a red box of Korean chili paste, and a bag of Korean chili powder. (4) The scene shifts to the induction stove where a hand pours sesame oil from a yellow tin into the pot. (5) Minced garlic and strips of pork belly are added into the pot using wooden chopsticks. (6) The meat is stir-fried with garlic, turning from red to a grey-brown color. (7) A generous amount of kimchi is added from the jar into the sizzling pot. (8) Korean chili powder is sprinkled over the mixture, adding a vibrant red color. (9) Chopped cabbage and Enoki mushrooms are layered into the pot. (10) Hot water is poured into the pot, partially submerging the vegetables. (11) Hotpot balls and two beef stock cubes are added into the liquid. (12) Another scoop of Korean chili paste is stirred into the simmering broth. (13) Large chunks of white tofu are scooped with a spatula and placed into the soup. (14) A whole raw egg is cracked and carefully dropped into the center of the boiling pot. (15) Chopped green chili peppers are sprinkled as a final garnish. (16) The final shot shows the completed, bubbling Korean-style kimchi and pork belly stew.
